name: Agent Engineering Lab
description: A hands-on learning laboratory for understanding and building LLM Agents: daily notes, concepts, experiments and a progress record generated from this repository itself.

focus.description: Build the smallest Agent that actually runs — LLM client, tool calling, state and a loop that knows when to stop — before adopting any framework.

projects.name: TFT Agent Set 18
projects.description: A training-oriented rewrite of the TFT Agent. The goal is not feature completeness, but understanding Agent engineering through minimal implementations: a hand-written loop, state, tools and context before any framework.

projects.name: TFT Agent Set 17
projects.description: The product: LangGraph runtime, RAG, streaming, evaluation and deployment. Only ideas proven in Set 18 land here.

philosophy: How to implement a minimal version
